note: The twelve cross-owner boundaries of work order section 9. 'checks' name automated checks in scripts/release/checklist.py that give evidence today. A boundary with no passing end-to-end evidence stays unrun or partial; it is never inferred from component tests.

boundaries.required_evidence: Documented commands launch the manual product without untracked files or provider calls from health probes.
boundaries.gap: Only the local web draft workspace exists. There is no backend, health probe or capability endpoint to start or probe.

boundaries.required_evidence: Selected image is visible beside real proposals/references; corrections preserve source bytes and provenance.
boundaries.gap: No source admission, Gemini intake or source review view exists. Frozen sheets, expected transcriptions and cases C01-C05 are ready.

boundaries.required_evidence: Exact fields, enums, errors, offsets and versions agree; scientific inputs are not browser floats.
boundaries.gap: Web side only: exported scalars are strings and parseExact agrees with the DB-SC-1 oracle. No backend or generated client exists to compare enums, errors and versions.

boundaries.required_evidence: Changed input needs new approval; duplicate starts reconcile one run; same key/different body conflicts.
boundaries.gap: No approval or run routes exist.

boundaries.required_evidence: Draft changes neither mutate nor implicitly revoke an accepted frozen run; stop reflects actual worker state.
Only permitted typed actions reserve work; verifier/binding output controls labels rather than prose.
boundaries.gap: No deepagents runtime or Groundwork adapter exists. Cases C06, C08, C09 are ready.

boundaries.required_evidence: Distinct request, plan, approval and job; future allowance and continuation scope explicit.
Wrong problem, missing/invalid partner, nonpositive margin or unsupported horizon cannot produce checked separation.
boundaries.gap: No suggestion verifier exists. Oracle controls C10/C11 are ready. Checked separation is NOT advertised: the positive-margin full-stack case is marked unshipped.

boundaries.required_evidence: Actual/hypothetical ancestry remains distinct; old artifacts remain byte-identical.
boundaries.gap: No revisions or observation proposals exist. Case C12 is ready.

boundaries.required_evidence: Exact downloaded bytes reopen against expected identities; private-source omission and its limits are disclosed.
boundaries.gap: The web draft download is an input record only; the editor has no reopen action and there are no reports or identities.

boundaries.required_evidence: Advertised checked suggestions pass prepared native replay; browser support is separately tested or unsupported.
boundaries.gap: No checker, artifact or replay exists. Browser replay: unsupported.

boundaries.required_evidence: Outage, interruption and restart preserve evidence and reconcile operations without silent duplicates.
boundaries.gap: No store, jobs or provider layer exists. Case C07 is ready.
